title: Begg Receives Tusk Honour: Begg becomes first woman to win; Niassa teams gain recognition
summary_full: Dr. Colleen Begg has received the prestigious 2026 Prince William Award for Conservation in Africa, reflecting her commitment to safeguarding wildlife in Mozambique's Niassa Special Reserve. For over twenty years, she has worked alongside her husband to establish the Niassa Carnivore Project, focusing on large carnivore conservation through community engagement. This accolade underscores the vital role of sustainable practices and local leadership in conservation efforts.
